name: Plan an item with a preferred shop and expected price
description: Verifies optional planning details are saved and contribute to the dashboard estimate without recording a purchase.
setup: Create a shop named Raju Store
Create a list named Monthly groceries
steps: Open Monthly groceries and add an item named Rice through Custom Input
Set Raju Store as the preferred shop
Set the expected unit price to 60 INR
expected: Rice shows its preferred planning details in the list and Home shows 60 INR under Estimated pending without creating a purchase.

name: Record an actual purchase separately from a plan
description: Verifies a purchase is created only through the explicit purchase workflow and keeps its actual price separate from the expected price.
setup: Create a list item named Rice with an expected unit price of 60 INR
steps: Use Record on the unchecked Rice item
expected: Purchase history contains Rice at 58 INR while the planned item retains its expected price.

name: Completed items cannot create duplicate purchases
description: Verifies completed list entries remain visible but cannot open the separate purchase workflow.
setup: Add an item named Soap with an expected price of 50
expected: Soap displays its estimated price and no Record action is visible.

name: Build and retain a shop catalogue without creating a purchase
description: Verifies shop items are associated separately from a purchase record.
steps: Enter Tea in Items sold and save
expected: Tea appears under Other items sold and no purchase record is created.

name: Reject empty required forms without creating records
description: Verifies empty list, item, shop, and purchase forms are blocked safely.
steps: Open a new list and submit without a name
Open a new shop and submit without a name
Open a purchase and submit without item and price
expected: Each form displays a validation message and no record is created.
